lambda_slider.name: Lambda Slider
lambda_slider.description: QFEP λ parameter controller. The entropy drive dial: λ=0 (pure order) → λ=0.4 (edge of chaos) → λ=1 (dissolution). Grab and slide to tune how much a system values disorder vs order. Life exists at λ ≈ 0.3-0.5. DNA: calibration selects what the scale claims about where the right value lies (optimum = the painted apex, band = a tolerance, dispute = three schools, gap = the rail cut at the recommendation, none = an even ruler). Use #calibration:band.

dna.default: calibration=optimum - the legacy lineage segment for segment: ten gradient boxes at their old sizes, positions, colours, emission 0.3 and alpha 0.6, the rail in its old grey, and no scale plate. All existing placements untouched.
dna.was: one fixed gradient rail with the answer painted on in green - the note describing this axis shipped 2026-07-27 with no implementation; the write-up landed, the export did not
dna.note: The regions the variants bracket, flag and cut are read out of is_at_edge() (0.3-0.5) and the shipped default (0.4), never invented. Shared token with phi_slider - one axis, two files.

lambda_slider.qfep_connection: lambda_edge: the entropy drive dial itself — λ=0 pure order, 0.4 the edge of chaos, 1 dissolution. The project's own thermostat, graspable: the parameter that decides how much wildness a system is permitted.

phi_slider.name: Phi Slider
phi_slider.description: QFEP φ parameter controller. Rate of entropy change sensitivity: φ<0 (resists change) → φ=0 (neutral) → φ>0 (embraces change). Positive φ is the queer signature—valuing becoming over being. DNA: calibration selects what the scale claims about where the right value lies (optimum = the painted gradient, band = the queer-signature region as a tolerance, dispute = three schools, gap = the rail cut over the whole recommendation, none = an even ruler). Use #calibration:band.

dna.default: calibration=optimum - the legacy lineage segment for segment: ten gradient boxes, the grey rail, no scale plate. All existing placements untouched.
dna.was: one fixed purple-to-gold gradient rail with the answer painted on
dna.note: Regions read out of has_queer_signature() (phi > 0.2), the shipped default (phi = 0.3) and get_state_description()'s Queer Signature register, never invented. Shared token with lambda_slider - one axis, two files; the design argument lives in lambda_slider.gd's note.

phi_slider.qfep_connection: lambda_edge: the sensitivity dial — φ below zero resists change, above zero embraces it. The second hand on the QFEP clock: not how much entropy, but how the system FEELS about its rate.

qfep_formula_3d.name: QFEP Formula 3D
qfep_formula_3d.description: 3D visualization of the complete QFEP formula: QFE = F − λE(S) + φΔE(S,t). Each term glows with its signature color. Responds to lambda and phi slider changes. The theoretical anchor.

dna.default: posture=line, emphasis=none - line runs the original centring loop verbatim and emphasis=none leaves highlighted_term empty, so all 13 existing placements render exactly as before
dna.was: one hard-coded horizontal row of TextMesh with nothing lit: the script's own critical_parameter (highlighted_term, which term the equation is read through) was reachable only from code that never called it, and the posture of the line was not a parameter at all
dna.note: declared by hand 2026-07-29 - the sweep refused it as NO TURNABLE KNOBS because the five existing exports (animate, pulse_speed, glow_intensity, font_size, depth) had no apply_grid_config to reach them, and none of them changes what the formula argues. The axis is named posture, not layout, because curation_station already owns the key `layout` with an overlapping vocabulary (row/corner/ring)
dna.framing_note: emphasis lights one term inside a whole equation, so fitting the entire formula renders the lit glyph too small to read — 2.22% at default framing. 0.72 moves in far enough to see which term is lit while still holding the posture values, which change the whole layout.

qfep_formula_3d.qfep_connection: synthesis: the whole formula in the air — QFE = F − λE(S) + φΔE(S,t), each term glowing its signature color, answering the sliders live. The project's thesis as a walkable object: free energy, entropy drive, and the felt rate of change, summed.

qfep_sandbox_console.name: QFEP Sandbox Console
qfep_sandbox_console.description: Full QFEP parameter control panel combining lambda_slider, phi_slider, F meter, E(S) meter, and real-time visualization. Find the edge of chaos. You have earned the force.
qfep_sandbox_console.qfep_connection: λ and φ under your hands, F = E − λS recomputed at every nudge: the free-energy principle demoted from law to console. 'You have earned the force' — yet the panel grants agency only over the knobs the framework already decided exist.

bifurcation_walkway.name: Bifurcation Walkway
bifurcation_walkway.description: A corridor where your position = r parameter in the logistic map. Walk through the phase transition: stable → period doubling → chaos → windows of order. The bifurcation diagram made walkable.
bifurcation_walkway.qfep_connection: The logistic map's r parameter IS the Î» drive. At râ‰ˆ3.57, chaos begins â€” this is Î»_edge, where life exists. You walk through the phase space of orderâ†’chaos.

edge_of_chaos_orb.name: Edge of Chaos Orb
edge_of_chaos_orb.description: A sphere that visualizes the current QFEP state. Color and behavior shift based on global λ and φ values. Green and dancing when at the edge of chaos (λ≈0.4, φ>0).
edge_of_chaos_orb.qfep_connection: One sphere compresses the whole regime: blue frozen, red dissolved, green when λ sits near 0.4 with φ consenting — plus a gold 'window of order' the three-state taxonomy has to smuggle in as a fourth. The wobble is what the compression can't hold still.

grab_sphere_F.name: F Term Sphere
grab_sphere_F.description: Grabbable sphere representing F (Free Energy) - the order-seeking, pattern-finding drive. Blue glow.
grab_sphere_F.qfep_connection: F, free energy, in your hand and glowing blue — the order-seeking, pattern-finding drive, the term that wants the world to make sense. Grab it and you hold the project's model of the mind's hunger for structure: the force that compresses, predicts, and resolves. First term of the equation, and the one every algorithm in this curriculum secretly serves.

grab_sphere_E.name: E Term Sphere
grab_sphere_E.description: Grabbable sphere representing E(S) (Entropy) - the freedom and possibility space. Red glow.
grab_sphere_E.qfep_connection: E(S), entropy, glowing red — the freedom and the possibility space, everything F would tidy away. Grab it and you hold disorder not as decay but as *room*: the vast unmapped territory from which anything new must come. The equation subtracts it (−λE) because order costs freedom, and the whole drama of QFEP is how much freedom to spend.

grab_sphere_lambda.name: Lambda Term Sphere
grab_sphere_lambda.description: Grabbable sphere representing λ (lambda) - the entropy drive parameter. Green glow.
grab_sphere_lambda.qfep_connection: λ, the entropy drive, glowing green — the dial that weighs how much freedom the system spends against order. Grab it and you hold the single most important number in the project: λ near zero is crystal, λ near one is dissolution, and λ≈0.3–0.5 is where life is. Everything alive is a setting of this sphere.

grab_sphere_phi.name: Phi Term Sphere
grab_sphere_phi.description: Grabbable sphere representing φ (phi) - the rate sensitivity, the queer signature. Magenta glow.
grab_sphere_phi.qfep_connection: φ, the rate sensitivity, glowing magenta — the queer signature, the term that cares not about entropy but about its *rate of change*. Grab it and you hold the project's most particular idea: that what matters is not order or disorder but the system's stance toward becoming, φ>0 embracing change, φ<0 resisting it. The term that makes the equation about time, and desire.

qfep_reactor.name: QFEP Reactor
qfep_reactor.description: Central orb that visualizes the current QFEP state. Pulses and glows based on lambda and phi. Blue=order, green=edge of chaos, red=dissolution. The heart of the laboratory.
qfep_reactor.qfep_connection: The central orb that visualizes the whole QFEP state — pulsing and glowing as λ and φ move, blue toward order, hot toward dissolution, alive at the edge. The laboratory's master gauge: one object that reads the entire equation at once and shows you, at a glance, which zone the world is currently in.

entropy_meter.name: Entropy Meter
entropy_meter.description: Visual gauge showing current E(S) entropy level. A filling tube that responds to lambda. Low=blue, medium=green, high=red. Classic lab instrument aesthetic.
entropy_meter.qfep_connection: The tube reads E(S), but the value poured into it is λ itself, renamed at the signal boundary and lerped at smoothing 5 so the liquid never startles. Lab-instrument calm is the actual product: a scalar in glass, made slow enough to trust.

edge_detector.name: Edge Detector
edge_detector.description: Handheld tool that detects edge of chaos. Beeps faster and glows brighter as lambda approaches 0.4. The antenna vibrates at the sweet spot. A tricorder for QFEP.
edge_detector.qfep_connection: Criticality shrunk to a handheld reading: distance from λ≈0.4 becomes beep interval and glow, and the instrument says nothing about the system except how far it stands from one privileged number. A detector like this doesn't find the edge of chaos — it legislates where the edge is allowed to be.

phase_cube.name: Phase Cube
phase_cube.description: A cube that shows phase transitions. SOLID (crystal, λ<0.25) → COMPLEX (edge, 0.25<λ<0.55) → GAS (dissolution, λ>0.55). Visual metaphor for matter states as QFEP states.
phase_cube.qfep_connection: Matter's phase diagram hijacked as pedagogy: two thresholds (λ 0.25 and 0.55) cut a continuum into solid, complex, gas, while a dissolution scalar does the actual becoming between the labels. The cube stays a cube throughout — it is the category that melts.

qfep_oscilloscope.name: QFEP Oscilloscope
qfep_oscilloscope.description: Real-time waveform display showing F (blue) and E(S) (red) over time. Watch the oscillation between order and entropy. Classic lab monitor aesthetic.
qfep_oscilloscope.qfep_connection: F in blue, E(S) in red, two hundred samples deep at 0.05 s: the order–entropy negotiation flattened into traces you can watch cross. What the screen makes thinkable is phase relation — not how much order, but who answers whom, and how late.

reactive_particle_field.name: Reactive Particle Field
reactive_particle_field.description: A field of 100 particles that respond to lambda and phi. Low λ: ordered grid. Edge λ: swirling dance. High λ: chaotic swarm. Phi affects dynamics. The formula made physical.
reactive_particle_field.qfep_connection: A hundred rigid bodies, gravity off, damping high, pulled between grid targets and injected noise — λ decides which force wins, and the middle band's swirl is hand-scripted rather than emergent. Order here is not stillness but a stronger subscription; the particles never stop being pushed both ways.

crystal_cluster.name: Crystal Cluster
crystal_cluster.description: Ordered crystalline formation representing λ=0 (pure order). Alias for crystalcluster primitive.

dna.default: growth=scatter, facet=taper - scatter makes the same six rng draws in the same order as the shipped code and taper keeps the 0.7 top ratio, so all 27 existing placements are vertex-for-vertex unchanged
dna.was: five hex prisms at fixed jittered positions with fully free rotation, hard-coded: an artifact registered as lambda=0 pure order whose only arrangement was a scatter, with no way for a map to say what kind of order it meant
dna.note: declared by hand 2026-07-29 - the sweep refused it as NO TURNABLE KNOBS because the script exposed no exports at all; growth is the macro order (how the five relate) and facet the micro order (the habit of one crystal)

crystal_cluster.qfep_connection: λ=0 made solid: a crystalline formation, pure order, frozen pattern. The cold end of the spectrum where F has won completely and E(S) is starved to nothing — perfect structure, perfect death. Beautiful and uninhabitable, the pole the edge-of-chaos rooms define themselves against.

reactive_particles.name: Reactive Particles
reactive_particles.description: Alias for reactive_particle_field. Particles that respond to λ and φ parameters.
reactive_particles.qfep_connection: A particle field that answers λ and φ directly — move the dials and the swarm reorganizes, order to chaos to edge, live feedback between the equation and its consequences. The laboratory's responsiveness made ambient: proof that the terms are not decoration but *controls*, and the world obeys them.

crystal_formation.name: Crystal Formation
crystal_formation.description: Ordered crystal cluster for λ=0 zone. Pure order, frozen pattern.
crystal_formation.qfep_connection: The λ=0 zone as a grown crystal — order so complete nothing can move. It states the equation's left boundary: maximal free energy, minimal entropy, a pattern that will never surprise you again. The chapter needs it visible so the aliveness of the middle can be felt as a departure from it.

edge_particles.name: Edge Particles
edge_particles.description: Particles at the edge of chaos (λ≈0.4). Dancing, self-organizing, alive.
edge_particles.qfep_connection: Particles at λ≈0.4 — dancing, self-organizing, alive. Not frozen like the crystal, not scattered like the chaos, but caught in the narrow band where order and freedom negotiate continuously. This is what the equation predicts life looks like: perpetual motion that neither settles nor flies apart.

emergence_zone.name: Emergence Zone
emergence_zone.description: A zone where complexity emerges. Particles self-organize at the edge of chaos.
emergence_zone.qfep_connection: A zone where complexity emerges — particles self-organizing at the edge of chaos. The chapter's central claim made walkable: that structure worth having is not imposed (λ=0) nor absent (λ=1) but *emergent*, arising on its own in the thin habitable band. Stand in it and you stand where the project locates aliveness.

random_cubes.name: Random Cubes
random_cubes.description: Chaotically arranged cubes representing high entropy. Random positions, rotations, scales.
random_cubes.qfep_connection: Cubes in chaotic disarray — high entropy as furniture, random positions and rotations and scales. The grid's own elements thrown to the λ=1 wind, order's vocabulary spoken as noise. Between this and the ordered_grid the whole spectrum stretches.

particle_chaos.name: Particle Chaos
particle_chaos.description: High-entropy particle system. Maximum spread, random velocities, dissolution.
particle_chaos.qfep_connection: A high-entropy particle system at maximum spread — random velocities, no structure, the λ=1 extreme where possibility has swallowed pattern whole. Freedom without form: the chapter's demonstration that too much entropy is as dead as too little.

ordered_grid.name: Ordered Grid
ordered_grid.description: Perfectly aligned cube grid representing low λ. Order, predictability, rigidity.
ordered_grid.qfep_connection: A perfectly aligned cube grid — low λ as architecture. Predictability, rigidity, every cell where you expect it: the comfort and the tomb of pure order. The curriculum's own grid, pushed to the λ=0 extreme where structure becomes a cage.

chaos_particles.name: Chaos Particles
chaos_particles.description: λ=1 dissolution zone. Particles exploding outward, no coherence, pure entropy.
chaos_particles.qfep_connection: λ=1: the dissolution zone, particles exploding outward with no coherence, pure entropy. The hot end of the spectrum where E(S) has won and F cannot hold anything together — total freedom, total meaninglessness. The pole opposite the crystal, and equally uninhabitable.

dissolving_form.name: Dissolving Form
dissolving_form.description: A mesh that appears to dissolve/disintegrate. High λ territory.
dissolving_form.qfep_connection: A mesh caught mid-disintegration — high-λ territory, form losing its own edges. The visible act of order surrendering to entropy, structure remembered just long enough to be seen dissolving. The equation's right slope made motion.

complexity_pattern.name: Complexity Pattern
complexity_pattern.description: Game of Life cellular automata at edge of chaos. Self-organizing complexity.
complexity_pattern.qfep_connection: Conway's Game of Life running at the edge of chaos — self-organizing complexity from the simplest rules. The canonical proof that the edge is real: gliders and oscillators and still lifes, none designed, all emergent, the cellular-automata chapter's crown reappearing here as evidence for the equation's central band.

turing_pattern.name: Turing Pattern
turing_pattern.description: Reaction-diffusion Turing pattern. Spots, stripes, labyrinths.

edge_core.name: Edge Core
edge_core.description: Central orb for edge of chaos. Pulsing, alive, responsive to λ.
edge_core.qfep_connection: The central orb of the edge of chaos — pulsing, alive, responsive to λ. Turn the dial toward 0.4 and it quickens; this is the equation's beating heart, the place where F and E(S) balance closely enough that neither wins and *complexity* becomes possible. The single most important object in the laboratory.

rigid_sculpture.name: Rigid Sculpture
rigid_sculpture.description: Static crystalline form for φ<0 zone. Resists change.
rigid_sculpture.qfep_connection: A static crystalline form for the φ<0 zone — not just ordered but *resisting* change, order that has taken a stance against becoming. Where the crystal is merely frozen, this one is frozen on purpose, the conservative signature made sculpture.

fluid_form.name: Fluid Form
fluid_form.description: Morphing iridescent form for φ>0 zone. Embraces becoming.
fluid_form.qfep_connection: A morphing iridescent form for the φ>0 zone — a shape that embraces becoming, never settling, iridescence as the color of change welcomed. The queer signature made beautiful: not resisting time like the rigid sculpture, but flowing with it, difference as the point rather than the threat.

preserved_pattern.name: Preserved Pattern
preserved_pattern.description: Static checkerboard that never changes. Conservative φ<0.
preserved_pattern.qfep_connection: A checkerboard that never changes — φ<0 made flat and eternal. Conservation as a value: the pattern that has decided the past was correct and the future is a threat. The equation's other resistance, not to disorder but to time.

transforming_pattern.name: Transforming Pattern
transforming_pattern.description: Constantly evolving wave pattern. Queer φ>0 signature.
transforming_pattern.qfep_connection: A constantly evolving wave pattern — the φ>0 queer signature in motion. Where the preserved checkerboard freezes, this one refuses to hold still, its identity located in transformation rather than persistence. The equation's third term made visible: what matters here is the rate of change, and this pattern has chosen to change.

earths_delight.name: earths_delight
earths_delight.description: Procedurally sculpts noise terrain and scatters mutated Bosch-inspired plants across it.
earths_delight.qfep_connection: Paradise, pleasure, and hell are three palettes assigned by noise over one Perlin terrain — judgment as colormap, not geography. Every plant is the same stem-bulb-leaf kit resampled at mutation_factor 0.7, so the edenic and the monstrous differ only in seed.

PipilottiRistWorld.name: PipilottiRistWorld
PipilottiRistWorld.description: Immersive projection space with animated color grading, floating sculptures, and video-mapped surfaces.
PipilottiRistWorld.qfep_connection: Saturation is installed as environment before any object exists — fog, sky, and ambient light tinted, then a post-processing shader keeps shifting the grade over everything. Immersion here means color deciding in advance what a body can be seen as.

science_desk.name: science_desk
science_desk.description: a lab workstation with cabinets, countertop equipment, and built-in lighting.
science_desk.qfep_connection: White CSG boxes with cabinets and built-in lighting: the laboratory as furniture-before-science, a stage that makes whatever lands on the countertop read as evidence. The desk asserts objectivity the way a plinth asserts art.

science_glasses.name: science_glasses
science_glasses.description: Generates a full suite of laboratory glassware, adapters, and accessories with translucent materials.
science_glasses.qfep_connection: Condenser coil and 'experimental' wobble come from the same tube-extrusion routine — one fed a parametric helix, the other Perlin noise. Glassware's authority turns out to be parametric: precision and eccentricity are one algorithm with different curves plugged in.

fuzzy_cloud.name: fuzzy_cloud
fuzzy_cloud.qfep_connection: Fifteen blobs wearing three thousand hairs each — softness purchased by count, the way Donovan builds clouds from toothpicks. Nothing is fuzzy at the level of the datum; every strand is a placed cylinder, so the haze is entirely a victory of quantity over form.

edge_of_chaos_unlocked.name: Edge of Chaos Unlocked
edge_of_chaos_unlocked.description: Reaction-diffusion system with the UNLOCKED lambda slider that the QFEP_Edge_Of_Chaos map withheld. Drag lambda from 0 (frozen crystal) through 0.4 (Turing patterns emerge) to 1.0 (pure noise). The artifact answers the critical text's question: adjusting IS knowledge. Witnessing IS knowledge. Different kinds.

AnickaYiLab.name: AnickaYiLab
AnickaYiLab.qfep_connection: The containment furniture — petri dishes, flasks, bioreactors — is assembled first, and then forty bacteria are instanced already outside it, drifting through the fog on their own MultiMesh. Escape is never staged as accident; the code simply never wrote a lid.

snap_tetra_puzzle.name: Snap Tetra Puzzle
snap_tetra_puzzle.description: Snap-point tetrahedron assembly puzzle. Represents constraint satisfaction and ordered structure — how Free Energy minimization drives systems toward specific geometric configurations.
snap_tetra_puzzle.qfep_connection: Each snapped connection reduces prediction error. The final locked form is minimum free energy.

snap_cube_puzzle.name: Snap Cube Puzzle
snap_cube_puzzle.description: Snap-point octahedral assembly puzzle. Represents ordered structure and constraint — the crystalline end state of a system minimizing free energy.
snap_cube_puzzle.qfep_connection: The rigid, ordered form that emerges when a system fully minimizes its free energy (F → minimum, S → low).

qfep_term_compass.name: QFEP Term Compass
qfep_term_compass.description: A glass disc with five glowing nodes — F, E(S), λ, Δ(S,t), φ — each labeled with the sequence where the player first met it. Standing at the center, the entire formula glows. The retroactive recognition artifact: every prior sequence was secretly building a term.
qfep_term_compass.qfep_connection: Five glowing nodes, each pinned to the sequence where its term was first walked — F to forces, E(S) to randomness, λ to the automata. The formula is staged as memory rather than revelation: every earlier room was secretly a variable, and standing at the centre is just noticing.

shannon_workbench.name: Shannon Workbench
shannon_workbench.description: An interactive workbench for the binary entropy function. One slider drives p ∈ [0,1]; a 16×16 Bernoulli(p) bit grid regenerates from a fixed seed (same draws, migrating threshold), a live readout shows H(p) bits/symbol and the theoretical-min bit count, and a glowing red marker rides the entropy hill H(p) = -p log₂ p - (1-p) log₂(1-p) above the table. The slope of H is the rate at which structure becomes possible; the peak (p=0.5) is where structure is maximally absent. Sister to shannon_entropy_meter (this is the source side; that is the measurement side).

cantor_diagonal_workbench.name: Cantor Diagonal Workbench
cantor_diagonal_workbench.description: An interactive Cantor diagonal workbench. One slider drives N ∈ {4, 8, 16, 24, 32}; a list of N random binary reals fills the floating grid, the (i, i) diagonal cells are halo'd in gold, and the bottom row builds the constructed real d bit-by-bit in red — where d[i] = 1 − list[i][i]. Thin orange leaders connect each diagonal cell to its red d-cell, showing 'this bit became that bit, flipped'. The readout reports d's prefix, the 'd ≠ row_k for all k' statement, and the conclusion: the reals are uncountable. Paired with /cantor-diagonal-gallery (web cells frozen at 8 (N, rule) combinations) — this is the live, hand-cranked version.

russell_paradox_workbench.name: Russell's Paradox Workbench
russell_paradox_workbench.description: An interactive Russell's paradox workbench. One slider walks through 6 set definitions ∈ {E, A, C, S, R, Frame}; a translucent disc floats above the plate and redraws to match. For E and C (well-formed predicates) the disc is calm blue with example element dots. For A = {x : x is a set} the disc turns amber and a 'including A itself' tag exposes the self-reference. For S = {x : x ∈ x} it shrinks to a small amber disc with one example dot — consistent self-containment. At cell 5 the disc turns RED with a wavy perimeter, and two orange arrows orbit the disc labeled 'R∈R ⇒ R∉R' and 'R∉R ⇒ R∈R' — chained tip-to-tail into a single closed contradiction loop that spins in space. At cell 6 the disc vanishes and only the loop remains, orbiting a '?'. A consistency lamp on the left glows green / amber / red-blinking by verdict. A ZFC card fades in at cells 5-6 explaining why the axiom of separation foils Russell. Paired with /russell-paradox-gallery — this is the live, hand-cranked version.

qfep_balance_workbench.name: QFEP Balance Workbench
qfep_balance_workbench.description: Four-knob console for the QFEP formula. Player turns F, E(S), lambda, phi sliders; a radar chart shows the current quadrilateral; the dominant timeline phase color tints the readout. The frame made into a balance.

microstate_counter.name: MicrostateCounter
microstate_counter.description: Entropy counts the ways: S = k log W - one macrostate, astronomically many microstates.

possibility_space_cloud.name: PossibilitySpaceCloud
possibility_space_cloud.description: Entropy is the size of the space of what could be - few accessible states vs many.

entropy_fan.name: EntropyFan
entropy_fan.description: More ways to be is more entropy - possibility itself is what S measures.

f_order_bench.name: F Order Bench
f_order_bench.description: Free-energy minimization building a crystal - minimize F alone and you get a perfect, frozen, dead thing.

f_order_room.name: F Order Room
f_order_room.description: A room-scale crystal palace: pure F, perfect order, flawless and motionless - and its deadness.

lambda_dial_bench.name: Lambda Dial Bench
lambda_dial_bench.description: The lambda dial sweeping 0 to 1: crystal at 0, noise at 1, living complexity at lambda approx 0.4.

phi_rate_bench.name: Phi Rate Bench
phi_rate_bench.description: Phi is sensitivity to the rate of change - a pattern that survives only by moving; freeze it and it dies.

phi_becoming_room.name: Phi Becoming Room
phi_becoming_room.description: A room of becoming - forms held alive by their own rate of change; stop and they collapse.

qfep_reactor_toy.name: QFEP Reactor Toy
qfep_reactor_toy.description: The whole formula in your hand: three knobs F, lambda, phi and a chamber flickering order to chaos.

qfep_reactor_bench.name: QFEP Reactor Bench
qfep_reactor_bench.description: Set F, lambda, phi and watch a dead-ordered or dead-random system flicker into life at the edge.

qfep_formula_toy.name: QFEP Formula Toy
qfep_formula_toy.description: The equation QFE = F - lambda*E(S) + phi*dE(S,t) as a held object - a machine to think with.
